svg.title: integrity
svg.desc: integrity: a recorded terminal session, 8 s, looping. Steps: integrity: a folder, a file, a link elsewhere, a dangling link or nothing, against a missing, empty or full target

g.text: folder-to-missing: the file shows through the link
folder-to-missing: the target got the file
folder-to-missing: doctor: links as the profile says
folder-to-missing: rollback gives the same tree
folder-to-missing: what was written through the link is kept
folder-to-empty: the file shows through the link
folder-to-empty: rollback gives the same tree
folder-to-empty: the empty target is empty again
folder-to-full: the link shows the target
folder-to-full: the entry is in the backup
folder-to-full: the summary says where it went
folder-to-full: rollback gives the same tree
folder-to-full: the target keeps its files
file-to-missing: settings keeps its keys through the link
file-to-missing: rollback gives the original settings back
link-elsewhere: the link points at the target
link-elsewhere: rollback gives the old link back
link-elsewhere: the old folder is untouched
dangling-link: the link points at the target
dangling-link: rollback gives the dangling link back
nothing-there: the link points at the target
nothing-there: doctor: links as the profile says
copy-from-missing: setup refuses a copy from nowhere
copy-from-missing: and says what is missing
reinstall: the second setup changes no link
reinstall: one rollback gives the same tree
reinstall: a second rollback has nothing to undo
migration-new-machine: setup on the new machine exits 0
migration-new-machine: doctor: links as the profile says
